parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the main teachings from Qurʾan 17.34.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain Muhammad’s treatment of those who lived close to him. You must refer to Hadith 309
and at least one other Hadith you have studied.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
To what extent does Islam promote social care? You should refer to different points of view.

EITHER

text: Read the following text passages then answer the questions which follow.

Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza’i (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
The Prophet (ملسو هيلع هللا ىلص) said, “He who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him be kind to his neighbour;
and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him show hospitality to his guest; and he who
believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him either speak good or remain silent”. [Muslim].

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the Muslim belief in God.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘For a Muslim the only essential belief is the Oneness of Allah (tawhid).’ Evaluate this
statement. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how marriage (nikah) is performed in Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the importance of marriage for society. You should refer to Islam in your answer.
